literal_meaning: চমক (আকস্মিক বিস্ময় বা ধাক্কা) খাওয়া (গ্রহণ করা)
figurative_meaning_en: To be stunned or taken aback for a moment
example_sentences_in_bangla: আকস্মিক শব্দে সবাই চমক খেয়ে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: He was taken aback upon hearing the news.
Everyone was startled by the sudden noise.
note: This idiom captures the instantaneous emotional response common in Bengali expressive language.
